elements.description:
A team directory with everyone's local time – status, role and team, how far ahead or behind you they are, whether
they're working, skills – grouped and filtered, as a list or a grid, with the team's best hour to meet.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the roster's name

properties.name: now
properties.description: The time now, epoch ms; by default the element's own clock, read every minute

properties.name: viewerTimezone
properties.description: "Your time": the viewer's IANA time zone; by default the browser's

properties.name: groupBy
properties.description: How members are grouped. Changed by the user unless a tc-group-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: filter
properties.description: What the filter box holds. Changed by the user unless tc-filter-change is prevented

properties.name: view
properties.description: A list or a grid of cards. Changed by the user unless tc-view-change is prevented

properties.name: selected
properties.description: The selected member's id. Changed by the user unless tc-selected-change is prevented

properties.name: locale
properties.description: The language for times, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-group-change
events.description: The grouping changed ({ groupBy }: RosterGroupChange); cancelable – prevented, `groupBy` stays as it was

events.name: tc-filter-change
events.description: The filter text changed ({ filter }: RosterFilterChange); cancelable – prevented, `filter` stays as it was

events.name: tc-view-change
events.description: List or grid ({ view }: RosterViewChange); cancelable – prevented, `view` stays as it was

events.name: tc-selected-change
events.description: A member was selected, or unselected ({ selected, member }: RosterSelectedChange); cancelable – prevented, `selected` stays as it was

events.name: tc-action
events.description: Message was pressed on a member ({ action: "message", member }: RosterAction)

functions.name: zoneOffset
functions.signature: zoneOffset(timeZone: string, at: number): number | null
functions.description: A time zone's offset from UTC at an instant, in minutes (Lisbon in summer: 60); null for a zone the browser doesn't know

functions.name: relativeOffset
functions.description: "+6 h ahead", "2.5 h behind", "same time" – how a zone's clock compares with the viewer's

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the roster's name

props.name: groupBy
props.description: How members are grouped – controlled when given

props.name: defaultGroupBy
props.description: The grouping on mount when `groupBy` isn't controlled

props.name: filter
props.description: The filter text – controlled when given

props.name: defaultFilter
props.description: The filter on mount when `filter` isn't controlled

props.name: view
props.description: List or grid – controlled when given

props.name: defaultView
props.description: The view on mount when `view` isn't controlled

props.name: selected
props.description: The selected member's id – controlled when given (null for none)

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The selection on mount when `selected` isn't controlled

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.type: (selected: string | null, member: RosterMember | null) => void
props.description: A member was selected, or unselected

props.name: onMessage
props.description: Message was pressed on a member

changelog: **People & profiles** - **Org Chart** (`tc-org-chart`) – reporting lines that fold, search that opens the way, pan and zoom, an outline when narrow. - **Person Hovercard** (`tc-person-hovercard`) – the profile card behind any name, with status and local time. - **Team Roster** (`tc-team-roster`) – a directory with everyone's local time and the team's best hour to meet. - **Relationship Graph** (`tc-relationship-graph`) – people and organisations around one of them, re-centring on click, with a keyboard list of every connection.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
